recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, centered portrait of a platinum blonde woman where the left half of her face is human and the right half is a cross-section revealing a complex internal mechanism of vintage gears, brass instruments, and electronic components. The subject wears a metallic, high-collared robotic suit against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical split between organic human skin and intricate mechanical internals.
Contrast between soft, high-key photographic lighting and sharp, technical line-art illustration.
Juxtaposition of classic Hollywood glamour with industrial, steampunk-inspired machinery.
Vertical alignment of the mechanical core with the central axis of the face.
coreInvariants: Stark white background with a thin black border frame.
Vibrant red lips as the central color pop.
Mechanical side rendered with pastel-toned metallic shading (lavender, gold, pink).
Vertical 'drip' lines extending from the top typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up portrait occupying 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red lips, positioned at the center-point of the split-face composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the human eye, moves down to the red lips, then right into the mechanical details, and finally up to the top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the head, emphasizing the silhouette and the clean, futuristic aesthetic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background and skin highlights) providing a clean, clinical foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (shadows, hair roots, and mechanical outlines) for depth and definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson Red (lips) and muted pastels (internal gears) for focal interest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation overall with a single point of high-saturation red.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muddy browns or earthy tones.
Keep skin tones desaturated and pale.

letterConstructionRules: Extended vertical stems that transform into thin, dripping lines.
Mix of uppercase and lowercase within single words.
Use of curly brackets to enclose secondary text elements.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Crossbars of 'A' and 'H' are thin and high.
Stems of letters in the top right extend downward like wires or rain.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A delicate, high-fashion serif paired with a technical, bracketed sans-serif for a 'human vs. machine' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-fashion, editorial contrast of the main name.
Matches the 'bionic' or computer-coded feel of the bracketed text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered portrait of a woman with platinum blonde hair in a 1940s wave style. The left half of her face is human with pale skin and red lips; the right half is a mechanical cross-section of gears, clockwork, and vacuum tubes in pastel metallic colors. She wears a silver chrome neck collar. Background is pure white with a thin black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a high-contrast serif name in the top right corner with thin lines dripping down from the letters. Place a secondary technical word in brackets to the right of the face, connected by a small dotted line.

verificationChecks: Is the split between human and machine perfectly vertical?
Are the lips the most saturated element in the image?
Do the typographic stems extend into vertical lines?
Is the background pure white without environmental detail?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic reflections on the collar
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of illustration and photography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the mechanical side looks like a cross-section, not a mask.
Check that the typography does not obscure the face.
Verify the metallic collar has a realistic chrome finish.
Confirm the hair texture is consistent across the split.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: High-Fashion Portrait] with [Concept: Mechanical Cross-section] using [Style: High-Key Surrealism] and [Graphic Element: Vertical Drip Typography].
